verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's own docs say it natively supports BM25 full-text search over string and []string attributes. It also offers trigram-indexed regex search and positions itself as a combined vector and full-text search engine, so no separate search engine is needed. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of FTS features (tokenizers, analyzers, phrase/fuzzy queries, field boosting) in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of full-text search quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run keyword/full-text search over documents inside the database without bolting on a separate search engine
